svg.text: MPx Squeeze v2 (Mini) · IISc CPDM · preliminary, not for manufacture
SEAL KIT · food-grade silicone 60 ShA, FDA 21 CFR 177.2600
bottle lip on P01 web; P10, P13
P01 land on cassette top face
tap face in P10; P12 ferrule
P13 coupler on stem thread shoulder
20 µm Dutch weave on 0.5 perforated plate, sinter-bonded
~0.2 mm fine layer on coarse 316L support; ISO 4003
Ø50 × 0.17; inspection only, never in the water path
28 mm PCO 1881; 500 mL and 1 L PET (prefilter Ø17 needs neck bore ≥ Ø19)
M12×1.0-6g: backflush coupler 13 now, optional UV cap later
cassette in holder 14, Ø56 × 6; fits clip-on phone lenses and Foldscope stages
PERFORMANCE, CASSETTE A (model; verify by bench tests)
1 Flux of each cassette vs ΔP (0.1–1.5 bar) on a rig; confirm the A-disc gain
2 Squeeze: bottle pressure vs hand force on 5 local 500 mL / 1 L bottles
3 Fouling: litres to half flow on tap and borewell water, with and without prefilter
4 Backflush: flow recovered after each cycle, 10 cycles
5 Challenge: 1, 2, 5, 10 µm PS beads; count before/after
6 Inspection: Nile red on disc A vs bare disc; particles counted by phone lens
7 Leak 1.5 bar air; drop 1 m on to concrete, 3 orientations
lift the disc out; it is the slide
